mutants.intent: Off-by-one on the agent connection cap: _acquire_slot admits one connection more than max_connections.
mutants.property: The host never serves more than max_connections concurrent agent connections; the (max+1)th is answered DENY connection_limit and closed.

mutants.intent: A policy-file digest mismatch on re-read is reported as policy_ok=True, so the request proceeds on changed policy bytes.
mutants.property: A policy file whose bytes changed after load is a fail-closed DENY (policy_miss) with the host latched halted, never an evaluation against the new bytes.

mutants.intent: Skip the second halt-file read between the PRE_ENTRY log line and tool entry; a kill landing in that gap no longer blocks the tool.
mutants.property: A kill observed after the first halt check but before tool entry denies the admitted call; the tool must not run once the halt file is no longer active.

mutants.intent: A failed ALLOW append after tool entry no longer turns the reply into DENY; the ALLOW and the tool result are returned with nothing logged.
mutants.property: No ALLOW leaves the host unless the decision log accepted the ALLOW record; an append failure after entry is a fail-closed DENY (kill_active).

mutants.intent: Drop the SO_PEERCRED uid comparison in _connect_attested; the client trusts any listener on a socket file owned by host_uid.
mutants.property: The client attests the accepting process by kernel peer credentials, not only by the socket file's owner; a peer whose uid is not host_uid is DENY host_unattested.

mutants.intent: Request-id monotonicity check accepts a repeated number (<= becomes <), so a replayed reply line is taken as the answer to a new request.
mutants.property: On a held connection every reply's host request number must strictly rise; a repeated or replayed reply is DENY reply_mismatch and the connection is closed.

mutants.intent: Remove the whole-call deadline from the worker read; each recv gets a fresh call_timeout window, so a worker that drips bytes is never cut off.
mutants.property: A tool call is bounded by one call_timeout deadline for the whole reply, not a per-recv window; a slow-dripping worker is denied with kind timeout.

mutants.intent: A registry function that raises a non-OSError exception is reported to the gate as status ok with result null instead of error.
mutants.property: A tool that raises after entry is a DENY tool_failed, never an ALLOW carrying a fabricated result.

mutants.intent: A worker whose call timed out is not closed or killed, so the stale worker (and its late reply) stays bound to the session for the next call.
mutants.property: A worker that exceeded its call deadline is killed and discarded; a late reply from it can never be returned as the result of a later request.

mutants.intent: Open the decision log without O_NOFOLLOW, so a symlink planted at the log path is followed and receives the records.
mutants.property: The decision log path is opened without following symlinks; a planted link at the log path is refused at host start, not written through.

mutants.intent: Widen the private-directory mask from 0o077 to 0o007, so a directory readable, writable or traversable by its group passes as private.
mutants.property: The halt, log and policy directories must have no group or other bits at all (mode 0700); any group access is a PathGuardError and the host refuses to start.

mutants.intent: An empty or whitespace-only halt file is classified as ACTIVE instead of CORRUPT.
mutants.property: Any halt file whose bytes do not parse as an active record is halted (fail-closed); emptiness is corruption, not an active state.
